title: Isolation — Ukulele Song-Form Accompaniment
description: Playable, song-structured high-G ukulele accompaniment using the documented harmony and characteristic rhythmic feel of “Isolation”. Designed for practice, not a note-for-note original guitar, vocal, bass or lead-riff transcription.
body:
Intro: G | F | G | G (repeat 2×)
Verse A: G | F | G | G (repeat 3×)
Chorus A: B | A | G | F | G (repeat 2×)
Verse B: G | F | G | G (repeat 3×)
Chorus B: B | A | G | F | G (repeat 2×)
Coda: G | F | G | G | G (repeat 1×)
notes:
High-G GCEA, no capo; concert pitch. Synth/bass-derived syncopation; clipped G–F ostinato; deliberately bright chromatic chorus.
Score section map: Intro (1–8) · Verse A (9–20) · Chorus A (21–30) · Verse B (31–42) · Chorus B (43–52) · Coda (53–57).
Original meter where supported; some rhythmic/meter details are adapted to the current single-meter, single-voice score engine. Rhythmic parts are original and song-characteristic, not copied riffs. Slash-bass/inversion details beyond the ukulele range are omitted.
Source harmonies: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Isolation_(Joy_Division_song)
